91: func parseOptOrder(d *caddyfile.Dispenser, _ interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
92: 	newOrder := directiveOrder
93: 
94: 	for d.Next() {
95: 		// get directive name
96: 		if !d.Next() {
97: 			return nil, d.ArgErr()
98: 		}
99: 		dirName := d.Val()
100: 		if _, ok := registeredDirectives[dirName]; !ok {
101: 			return nil, d.Errf("%s is not a registered directive", dirName)
102: 		}
103: 
104: 		// get positional token
105: 		if !d.Next() {
106: 			return nil, d.ArgErr()
107: 		}
108: 		pos := d.Val()
109: 
110: 		// if directive exists, first remove it
111: 		for i, d := range newOrder {
112: 			if d == dirName {
113: 				newOrder = append(newOrder[:i], newOrder[i+1:]...)
114: 				break
115: 			}
116: 		}
117: 
118: 		// act on the positional
119: 		switch pos {
120: 		case "first":
121: 			newOrder = append([]string{dirName}, newOrder...)
122: 			if d.NextArg() {
123: 				return nil, d.ArgErr()
124: 			}
125: 			directiveOrder = newOrder
126: 			return newOrder, nil
127: 		case "last":
128: 			newOrder = append(newOrder, dirName)
129: 			if d.NextArg() {
130: 				return nil, d.ArgErr()
131: 			}
132: 			directiveOrder = newOrder
133: 			return newOrder, nil
134: 		case "before":
135: 		case "after":
136: 		default:
137: 			return nil, d.Errf("unknown positional '%s'", pos)
138: 		}
139: 
140: 		// get name of other directive
141: 		if !d.NextArg() {
142: 			return nil, d.ArgErr()
143: 		}
144: 		otherDir := d.Val()
145: 		if d.NextArg() {
146: 			return nil, d.ArgErr()
147: 		}
148: 
149: 		// insert directive into proper position
150: 		for i, d := range newOrder {
151: 			if d == otherDir {
152: 				if pos == "before" {
153: 					newOrder = append(newOrder[:i], append([]string{dirName}, newOrder[i:]...)...)
154: 				} else if pos == "after" {
155: 					newOrder = append(newOrder[:i+1], append([]string{dirName}, newOrder[i+1:]...)...)
156: 				}
157: 				break
158: 			}
159: 		}
160: 	}
161: 
162: 	directiveOrder = newOrder
163: 
164: 	return newOrder, nil
165: }

424: func parseLogOptions(d *caddyfile.Dispenser, existingVal interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
425: 	currentNames := make(map[string]struct{})
426: 	if existingVal != nil {
427: 		innerVals, ok := existingVal.([]ConfigValue)
428: 		if !ok {
429: 			return nil, d.Errf("existing log values of unexpected type: %T", existingVal)
430: 		}
431: 		for _, rawVal := range innerVals {
432: 			val, ok := rawVal.Value.(namedCustomLog)
433: 			if !ok {
434: 				return nil, d.Errf("existing log value of unexpected type: %T", existingVal)
435: 			}
436: 			currentNames[val.name] = struct{}{}
437: 		}
438: 	}
439: 
440: 	var warnings []caddyconfig.Warning
441: 	// Call out the same parser that handles server-specific log configuration.
442: 	configValues, err := parseLogHelper(
443: 		Helper{
444: 			Dispenser: d,
445: 			warnings:  &warnings,
446: 		},
447: 		currentNames,
448: 	)
449: 	if err != nil {
450: 		return nil, err
451: 	}
452: 	if len(warnings) > 0 {
453: 		return nil, d.Errf("warnings found in parsing global log options: %+v", warnings)
454: 	}

456: 	return configValues, nil

part.text:
Implemented support for multiple `default_bind` addresses.

Changes:
- `caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/options.go`: Added `parseOptBind`, which accepts multiple addresses and accumulates repeated `default_bind` options.
- `caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/addresses.go`: Reads `default_bind` as `[]string` and sorts listener addresses for deterministic output.

Validated:
- `go test ./caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/...`
- `go test ./caddytest/integration -count=1`

Both pass.
